correctness.rationale: The first facet-foot hull is precisely the polar double pyramid conv(a²B°×{0},(0,±h)). Its facets have normals (v/a²,±1/h) for vertices v of B. Uniform |v|=R makes every normal square length R²/a⁴+1/h², giving rho² and exactly the Cartesian-product D² formula; no simplicial triangulation of facets is used. Scaling yields t→1/t and the displayed multiplier after four iterations. For t≠1 the D² base/height multipliers differ; for regular n-gon n≥5 the odd bipyramids have n+2 vertices and even prisms 2n vertices, excluding odd-step homothety. Distinct facet planes were independently reconstructed via convex hull for a regular pentagon; maximum vertex-set errors for D²,D⁴ were 7.8e-11,3.7e-11. Finite diagnostics corroborate, while polar face correspondence proves arbitrary dimensions and positive parameters.
